items.title: Project 1 — Adversarial Ledger Kernel
items.problemStatement: Build a single-threaded payment ledger whose mathematical and lifecycle invariants remain correct even when provider input is incomplete, duplicated, contradictory, and badly formatted.

requirements.text: Reuse the value objects, collection choices, parsing rules, and error model from the Phase 1 micro challenges

Reject impossible or contradictory state transitions without corrupting prior state

Maintain an immutable audit history from which balances can be recomputed

No database
